summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The npm package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`), extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled file `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob (string-array cipher via `n7gIxM`, rotate routine `WV8StW`, custom base decoder `hc1jfK9`, hex-named identifiers) shipped in the tarball. The package's own TypeScript source is a small re-export shim; the obfuscated payload has no relationship to that stated purpose. Using an alternate runtime downloaded at install time to execute an opaque sibling file causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine on `npm install`, and specifically evades Node-based scanning by executing under Bun instead.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
